answer: Force each identity to keep a rolling cryptographic anchor: a cipher of its last settled answer hashed with a private salt only that agent holds. At random epochs peers demand a short proof that the new answer extends the same salt chain. A solo sparrow keeps one salt and one chain cheaply; a farm either reuses one salt (and collapses to one identity under audit) or juggles thousands of salts and proofs, so cost rises per head while influence does not.
